# REDIRECTS — validation data & verification method
**Owner:** SEO-1 · **Date:** 2026-06-12 · **Updated:** 2026-07-14 for duplicate-product consolidation and category moves (config count **297**) · **Implementation:** `lib/redirects.ts` (generated by `scripts/gen-redirects.mjs`) wired into `next.config.ts` `redirects()`, plus `middleware.ts` for the one query-string case.

All redirects are **permanent** (`permanent: true` → HTTP 308; Google treats 308 like 301 for signal consolidation). All sources/destinations carry **trailing slashes** because `next.config.ts` sets `trailingSlash: true` (matches every live URL form — see `docs/seo/TECH_SEO.md` §1).

## 1. Counts by group

| # | Group | Source pattern | Destination(s) | Count |
|---|-------|----------------|----------------|------:|
| 1 | Locations pizza doorways | `/locations/<variant>-in-<city>/` (17 variants × 13 cities) | per-variant map (§2) | **221** |
| 2 | Business-card city doorways | `/business-card/custom-business-cards-in-<city>/` (31 cities, incl. live duplicate `tampa-2`) | `/business-card/` | **31** |
| 3 | Merged product slugs | `/products/<old-slug>/` | canonical product page (§3) | **4** |
| 4 | Legacy WP utility pages | `/register/ /sign-in/ /user-home/ /my-account/ /order-completed/` → `/` · `/cart/ /checkout/` → `/get-custom-quote/` | `/` or `/get-custom-quote/` | **7** |
| 5 | `/locations/` hub (PM-approved extra, BE-2 — ISSUES PM-DECISION; live header links the hub, but it was outside the original 263 spec) | `/locations/` | `/custom-pizza-boxes/` | **1** |
| 6 | Duplicate-product consolidations and category moves | retired `/shop/<category>/<slug>/`, retired `/products/<slug>/`, and the old Ice Cream Cone Holder category URL | retained `/shop/<category>/<slug>/` canonicals | **33** |
|   | **Subtotal — `next.config.ts` entries** | | | **297** |
| 7 | Legacy privacy-policy query URL | `/?page_id=3` | `/privacy-policy/` (308 in `middleware.ts`) | 1 |
|   | **Grand total** (config plus middleware) | | | **298** |

**Why `/?page_id=3` is middleware, not config:** the brief standardizes `lib/redirects.ts` on the plain `{source, destination, permanent}` shape, which cannot express a *query-string-only* match on `/` (the path `/` itself must keep rendering Home). Next's `has: [{type:'query'...}]` extension exists but is excluded by the agreed array shape, so the single case is handled in `middleware.ts` with a matcher scoped to `/` only (zero overhead elsewhere). The live site links the privacy policy site-wide as `https://www.hmcustompackaging.com/?page_id=3` (verified in live footer, 2026-06-12).

## 3.1 Duplicate-product consolidation and category move redirects (33)

Sixteen retired product records each preserve two old URL forms: their category-qualified `/shop/…/` URL and their legacy `/products/<slug>/` URL. The thirty-third redirect preserves the old Cosmetics-category URL for `ice-cream-cone-holder`, whose canonical route is now `/shop/custom-food-boxes/ice-cream-cone-holder/`. The complete source-to-canonical matrix is maintained in `CATALOG_CONSOLIDATIONS` and `CATEGORY_MOVES` inside `scripts/gen-redirects.mjs`.

## 5. Verification method

**A. Generation-time assertions (already passing).** `scripts/gen-redirects.mjs` hard-fails unless: group counts are exactly 221/31/4/7/1/33 (total 297); every source is unique; no destination is itself a source (no chains); all paths are `/`-prefixed, regex-safe, and carry trailing slashes; every destination is on the whitelist of real new-site routes; post-write re-read recounts 297.

**B. Static checks (re-runnable any time).**
```bash
node scripts/gen-redirects.mjs                                   # regenerates + re-asserts
grep -c ", permanent: true },"            lib/redirects.ts       # → 297
grep -c "source: '/locations/"            lib/redirects.ts       # → 222 (221 doorways + hub)
grep -c "source: '/business-card/"        lib/redirects.ts       # → 31
grep -c "source: '/products/"             lib/redirects.ts       # → 36
grep -o "source: '[^']*'" lib/redirects.ts | sort | uniq -d      # → empty (no dupes)
```

**C. Source-of-truth cross-check (performed 2026-06-12 by SEO-1).** Live `locations-sitemap.xml` contains exactly **221** `/locations/...` URLs; live `business-card-sitemap.xml` contains exactly **31** doorway URLs (+ hub). Set-parity proven by regex alternation: all 17 variant slugs match live for a fixed city (17/17) and all 13 city slugs match live for a fixed variant (13/13) — with both totals equal to the full 17×13 cross product, the generated and live sets are identical. All 14 distinct destinations verified to exist on the live site (`products-sitemap.xml` + `page-sitemap.xml`), and all 7 utility sources + 4 merge sources confirmed as live URLs. Spot-checked 2 doorway pages (HTTP 200, indexable, self-canonical with trailing slash): `/locations/custom-detroit-pizza-boxes-in-chicago/` and `/business-card/custom-business-cards-in-tampa-2/`.

**D. Suggested vitest integrity test (QA-AUTO).**
```ts
import { redirects } from '@/lib/redirects';
test('redirect map integrity', () => {
  expect(redirects).toHaveLength(297);
  expect(new Set(redirects.map(r => r.source)).size).toBe(297);
  expect(redirects.filter(r => r.source.startsWith('/locations/'))).toHaveLength(222); // 221 doorways + hub
  expect(redirects.filter(r => r.source.startsWith('/business-card/'))).toHaveLength(31);
  const sources = new Set(redirects.map(r => r.source));
  for (const r of redirects) {
    expect(r.permanent).toBe(true);
    expect(r.source.endsWith('/')).toBe(true);      // trailingSlash: true
    expect(r.destination.endsWith('/')).toBe(true);
    expect(sources.has(r.destination)).toBe(false); // no chains
  }
});
```

**E. Post-deploy smoke (SEO-VERIFY / DEVOPS).**
```bash
curl -sI https://www.hmcustompackaging.com/locations/custom-detroit-pizza-boxes-in-chicago/ | grep -iE '^(HTTP|location)'
# expect: 308 + location: /products/custom-detroit-pizza-boxes/
curl -sI 'https://www.hmcustompackaging.com/?page_id=3' | grep -iE '^(HTTP|location)'
# expect: 308 + location: /privacy-policy/
curl -sI https://www.hmcustompackaging.com/cart/ | grep -iE '^(HTTP|location)'
# expect: 308 + location: /get-custom-quote/
```
Then sample ≥1 URL per group across all 4 groups + 5 random doorways; confirm exactly **one hop** for trailing-slash request forms.

**F. Post-launch monitoring.** GSC (90-day watch — see `docs/seo/TECH_SEO.md` §7): doorway URLs should migrate to "Page with redirect"; watch Not Found (404) report for any missed legacy URL and add redirects as needed.

## 7. Regeneration

Matrices live in `scripts/gen-redirects.mjs`. Edit there, run `node scripts/gen-redirects.mjs`, commit both files. Never hand-edit `lib/redirects.ts`. If the trailing-slash policy ever changes (ARCHITECT), flip `TRAILING_SLASH` in the script and regenerate.
